evidence.claim: Acid is a Saibaman skill in Xenoverse 2 and is unavailable to CaCs.
Saibaman 2, used for Crystal Raids/Training, has Acid equipped.
Acid is used by Saibaman variants in Xenoverse 2; it is distinct from Saibabeam.
Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Acid skill ID 140, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Saibaman as its source; a separate raid-boss Acid is ID 143.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact lists Acid at IDs 140 and 143 under Super Skills, matching the normal Saibaman and raid-boss variants.
The Xenoverse 2 Saibaman page lists Acid on Saibaman 2, alongside Saibabeam, Brainwash Attack, Full Power Charge, Full Power Energy Blast Volley, Self-Destruct, and Break Strike.
A maintained 2021-update Xenoverse 2 community list explicitly includes Acid among skills unobtainable by CaC, independently corroborating the no-player-acquisition boundary.
A Xenoverse 2 move-list reference identifies Acid as a Super Attack on Saibaman variants, including Kyukonman and Tennenman, independently corroborating the Super classification and cast-only use.

resolved_fields.character_source: Saibaman / Saibaman 2; separate raid-boss Acid ID also documented
resolved_fields.acquisition_status: Not obtainable by CaC / no CaC unlock route documented

guardrails: Do not infer Ki cost from Xenoverse or other games.
Do not create a CaC acquisition route from NPC/Crystal Raid-only usage.
Do not promote to canonical skills.json without supported builder execution and required field coverage.
Do not merge skill ID 140 and raid-boss skill ID 143 without explicit canonical identity mapping.
Do not invent a CaC unlock route when the skill is documented as CaC-unavailable.
notes: 2026-09-24 follow-up: current indexed Xenoverse 2 references independently reconfirm Acid as a cast-only Super Attack and explicitly list Acid among skills unobtainable by CaC. Normal Acid ID 140 remains distinct from raid-boss Acid ID 143. Numeric Ki cost remains unverified; no cross-game cost inference was made.
